title: fia-document-monitor dataset item
description: Shared contract between the Apify Actor (producer) and ingestion/ingest.py (consumer). Metadata only: an item proves a document is listed on fia.com, not what it decided.

event_name.description: Event name exactly as listed by FIA

document_number.description: NN from a 'Doc NN - ...' title; empty when absent

published_at.description: Publication time as printed by FIA (e.g. '28.07.24 18:53 CET'), or empty. Not converted: FIA labels every time CET.

discovered_at.description: UTC time the Actor parsed the listing
